path.description: Path to the support ticket text file

read_ticket.description: Load the support ticket from disk

identify_ticket.description: Extract structured identity fields from the raw ticket text. Output is validated before classify_ticket starts — the classifier cannot receive incomplete or malformed extraction data.
identify_ticket.prompt:
Extract identity fields from the support ticket below.

Required fields:
- customer_id: the customer ID, format CUST-NNNN
- product_area: the product or service area this ticket concerns
  (e.g. "billing", "payment gateway", "account management", "API")
- product_version: the software version mentioned, or "unknown" if not stated
- reported_issue: one sentence describing the problem as reported
  (10–300 characters)

Return exactly these four fields. Any field missing or using an invalid
format will be rejected before this response is accepted.

Ticket:
{{ context.resources.read_ticket.content }}

classify_ticket.description: Classify the ticket using the identity extracted by identify_ticket. Output category and priority as discrete fields — these values are used by when-conditions on the five handler steps to determine which handler fires.
classify_ticket.prompt:
Classify this {{ context.resources.identify_ticket.product_area }} support ticket.

Reported issue: {{ context.resources.identify_ticket.reported_issue }}

Required fields:
- category: one of: bug | feature_request | billing | account | other
- priority: one of: low | medium | high | critical
- summary: one or two sentences for the support queue, explaining the issue
  and suggested routing (10–300 characters)

Return exactly these three fields. Any category or priority value outside the
allowed values will be rejected before your response is accepted.

handle_billing.description: Draft a reply for a billing inquiry. Only eligible when classify_ticket produced category == 'billing'. All other handlers are skipped.

handle_bug.description: Draft a reply for a bug report. Only eligible when classify_ticket produced category == 'bug'.

handle_feature.description: Draft a reply for a feature request. Only eligible when classify_ticket produced category == 'feature_request'.

handle_account.description: Draft a reply for an account issue. Only eligible when classify_ticket produced category == 'account'.

handle_other.description: Draft a reply for a ticket that does not fit the other categories. Only eligible when classify_ticket produced category == 'other'.
